battleground.title: Battleground Map
battleground.subtitle: Margin tiers, same shading as the popular-vote view
battleground.emptyHint: Margin data populates as votes accumulate. States with fewer than two non-zero candidates appear unshaded.

persuasion.title: Persuasion Drivers
persuasion.explanation: Why voters lean toward over . Each driver is signed: + = lift, − = drag. Drivers are relative within this list and only move the persuadable slice of each party's vote, so their real effect is small. Coattail rows are direct share tilts in %. A raw vote lead does not equal the sum of these bars.
persuasion.empty: No persuasion drivers computed for {state} yet. Drivers populate once vote data and enrichment data are loaded.
persuasion.driversGroup: Persuasion drivers (pts of the persuadable slice)
persuasion.moneyHint: Compares recent campaign spending: this turn counts fully, earlier spending fades over a few idle turns. Saved treasuries do not count.
persuasion.ceiling: Ceiling this cycle: at most {opponentSlice}% of {opponent}'s vote can be persuaded across to {focus}, and {focusSlice}% of {focus}'s vote can be persuaded away. Registration lean sets the starting split and how hard a party is to move, not the final share. These drivers add up to {net} pts of that movable slice.

nationalMood.title: National Mood
nationalMood.subtitle: The economy's push on the incumbent party's national vote
nationalMood.scaleNote: Scale runs from -{clamp} to +{clamp} pts. This shift is already inside the vote totals.
nationalMood.fatigue: Seeking a {term} consecutive term. The penalty side is scaled x{multiplier}.
nationalMood.responseCredit: Relief efforts soften the penalty by {percent}%.

democraticHealth.title: Democratic Health
democraticHealth.subtitle: Institutional strength changes how voters judge {party}.
democraticHealth.scaleNote: The election drag starts below 60 and grows as health falls.
democraticHealth.rulerNotRunning: The sitting President is not in this race, so the larger personal drag is not active.
democraticHealth.relief: A temporary constitutional measure reduces the extra presidential drag by {percent}%.

factorLedger.title: Factor Ledger
factorLedger.subtitle: Why a candidate is ahead or behind, broken into named factors. This is already inside the vote totals.

registration.title: Registration Influence
registration.noData: {state} ({stateId}): no registration data tracked for this state.
registration.populating: Registration data is populating in Phase 1.5 / Phase 2 prerequisite. This card will show {state}'s partisan-lean strength once seed data lands. Until then, the registration model defaults to neutral influence everywhere.
registration.intro: Partisan-lean baseline for {state}. Each party's share is the slow-moving registered-voter influence, not a vote-share guarantee. Voters still need persuasion to turn out and vote with their lean.
registration.normalizationNote: Note: shares total {pct}%, outside the normalized 95-105% band. Bootstrap renormalization may be pending.
registration.movableTitle: {party}: share of this party's vote that persuasion can still move in one cycle. The rest is locked in by their registration lean.
registration.movableNote: The movable figure is the share of each party's own vote that campaigning can shift in one cycle. A large lean means a large starting base and a small movable slice.

carveUp.title: {state} · Carve-up
carveUp.explanation: Each candidate's slice = registered voters × archetype × demographic affinity. Position alignment + influence drive appeal; favorability scales votes at resolution.
carveUp.empty: No projected slices for {state} yet. The carve-up populates once candidates have filed for this primary.

primaryCalendar.title: Primary Calendar
primaryCalendar.subtitle: Past contests show winner; future shows wave timing
primaryCalendar.empty: No primary calendar data yet. The wave schedule populates once the primary enters its stagger window.
primaryCalendar.inTurns: In {count, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}

campaignTargeting.title: Targeted ads
campaignTargeting.description: Raise a bonus with matching voter groups. Alignment and cohesion determine how strongly each group responds.
campaignTargeting.bonus: Average competitive bonus: {before}% to {after}% after these actions.
campaignTargeting.cost: Personal cost: {funds} campaign funds and {actions} actions.
campaignTargeting.decay: Target strength slowly returns toward zero, halving over 24 turns. Combined voter bonuses cannot exceed 25%. There is no fixed duration.
campaignTargeting.failed: Unable to load campaign audiences. Try again.
campaignTargeting.canvassPreview: Turnout input: +{boost} points. Estimated target turnout after blending: {before}% to {after}%.
campaignTargeting.canvassRules: Closely aligned groups respond more strongly. Turnout boosts halve every 6 turns under the new rules. Races already open retain their original rules. Mobilized voters can support any candidate.
campaignTargeting.canvassResult: Turnout input: +{boost} points (modifier {modifier}). Estimated target turnout: {before}% to {after}%.
campaignTargeting.standingDescription: Use targeted ads at any time. Target your home state, or choose another state while running for president.
campaignTargeting.loadCharacterFailed: Could not load your character. Refresh to try again.
campaignTargeting.actionFlavor: Build a temporary bonus with aligned voter groups in your home state. Presidential candidates can target other states.
campaignTargeting.atCap: This purchase would exceed the bonus cap. Choose fewer actions or let the bonus decay.
